summary: Iteration 10 (Pharma360 delivery + auth batch) — Backend: 5/5 pytest pass (58 wilayas seeded with Alger communes {Alger-Centre, Bab El Oued, El Harrach, Draria, Rouiba,...}; domicile pricing = base_fee(400) + commune(150 temp) = 550 DA verified; relais = agency fee only; pickup = 0; admin wilayas CRUD create/PUT/DELETE reflects in GET /delivery/wilayas; forgot-password always returns ok + read token from mongo password_reset_tokens; reset-password success, reuse->400, invalid->400, old pwd fails, new pwd logs in; GET/PUT /settings virtual_tour_url roundtrip). Frontend: /visite-360 renders virtual-tour-page with virtual-tour-placeholder (empty setting); Contact virtual-tour-link navigates to /visite-360; /reset-password?token=fakeXYZ shows form and submits -> 400 error state; /compte forgot-link switches AuthForm to forgot mode with forgot-email input that submits ok; /commande checkout: selecting Alger populates 11 commune options and shows domicile=400 DA (base), relais=350 DA (Yalidine agency fee only), pickup=Gratuit — matches backend math; checkout-login-toggle reveals login form; checkout-forgot-toggle reveals forgot form. All data-testids present and functional.

ui_bugs.issue: State default form.wilaya='Alger' but before wilayas fetch the <select> DOM shows first loaded option (01 — Adrar) after list arrives; the visible option and state can be out of sync until user selects a wilaya, causing initial commune dropdown to appear empty/placeholder even though state expects Alger. Consider syncing form.wilaya to first wilaya once list loads, or explicitly set to 'Alger' after fetch if present.

action_items: (Optional) Fix Checkout initial wilaya/state mismatch: on wilayas load, if form.wilaya not in list, default to first (or keep 'Alger' by ensuring select matches state).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is still large (1810 lines) — consider splitting delivery/wilayas + auth reset into routers.
compute_delivery falls back to settings.delivery_fees or WILAYA_DELIVERY (500) if wilaya doc missing — harmless but could log a warning for unknown wilaya names.

forgot_password uses request.headers['origin']; if missing, link becomes '/reset-password?token=...' with no host — set PUBLIC_URL env fallback (already partially handled) but confirm SENDER/RESEND is functional in prod.
Admin PUT /settings requires the full body (no partial merge). Frontend already sends full body. OK.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all target flows OK; 1 minor initial-state UX quirk)

seed_data_creation: 3 disposable test orders (Alger domicile / relais / pickup) created via /api/orders then deleted (mongo.orders + notifications) with stock +3 restored. 1 disposable user (test_reset_*@example.com) created for reset-password flow, then deleted along with its password_reset_tokens. Temporary Alger commune 'Alger-Centre' fee set to 150 DA for math test then reverted to original (0). virtual_tour_url temporarily set then restored to original empty value. Baseline (58 wilayas / 13 categories / 104 products) intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 backend + 5 frontend iteration-10 features validated. Reset-token flow requires reading Mongo directly because Resend does not deliver in test env — test_iteration10_delivery_auth.py::test_forgot_reset_password_flow already does this. Note the low-priority initial wilaya sync quirk in Checkout.jsx if you retest.
rca of the issue: N/A — no critical issues found. Minor UI quirk: when Checkout mounts, form.wilaya='Alger' but the wilayas list arrives later, so the <select> renders whatever the browser picks first (Adrar) while state still says Alger; user must click Alger to sync. Fix suggestion in action_items.
